## Definition

Adyen's release-notes directory routes readers to separate online payments, in-person payments, platforms and financial products, classic platforms, plugins, and Management API note areas. The 2026-09-15 captured root page contains navigation labels only. Exact changes, versions, compatibility and deployment state belong to the respective release-note pages and must be checked there.
